nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ and $z \in \mathbb{C}$. If $f$ is complex differentiable at $z$, then the Wirtinger derivative $\partial f / \partial \bar z$ of $f$ vanishes at $z$.
nodes.title: Vanishing of the Wirtinger derivative at points of complex differentiability

nodes.summary: For $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ and $z \in \mathbb{C}$, the Wirtinger derivative of $f$ at $z$ is $\frac{\partial f}{\partial \bar z}(z) = \frac{1}{2}\bigl(Df(z)(1) + i\,Df(z)(i)\bigr)$, where $Df(z)$ is the real derivative of $f$ at $z$, taken to be $0$ when $f$ is not real differentiable at $z$. When $f$ is real differentiable at $z$, this equals…
nodes.title: The Wirtinger derivative with respect to z̄

nodes.summary: Let $n \in \mathbb{N}$, let $s$ be an open subset of $\mathbb{C}^n$ and let $f : \mathbb{C}^n \to \mathbb{C}$ be complex differentiable at every point of $s$. Then the complex derivative $x \mapsto Df(x)$, with values in the complex linear maps $\mathbb{C}^n \to \mathbb{C}$, is continuous on $s$. Here $\mathbb{C}^n$ carries the Euclidean norm.
nodes.title: Holomorphic functions on open subsets of ℂⁿ have continuous derivative

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ and $z \in \mathbb{C}$. If $f$ is real differentiable at $z$ and its Wirtinger derivative $\partial f / \partial \bar z$ vanishes at $z$, then $f$ is complex differentiable at $z$.
nodes.title: Cauchy–Riemann criterion for complex differentiability

nodes.summary: Let $g : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ be real differentiable on all of $\mathbb{C}$, with continuous real derivative and compact support. Then there is a function $u : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$, real differentiable on all of $\mathbb{C}$, whose Wirtinger derivative satisfies $\frac{\partial u}{\partial \bar z}(z) = g(z)$ for every $z \in \mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Solving the ∂̄-equation for compactly supported C¹ data

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$, let $U \subseteq \mathbb{C}^n$ be open and connected, and let $K \subseteq U$ be compact with $U \setminus K$ connected. Then for every function $f : \mathbb{C}^n \to \mathbb{C}$ that is holomorphic on $U \setminus K$ there is a function $F : \mathbb{C}^n \to \mathbb{C}$ that is holomorphic on $U$ and agrees with $f$ on $U \setminus K$. Here $\mathbb{C}^n$ carries the Euclidean norm.
nodes.title: Hartogs extension theorem
